items.title: Live - Persona 5 Royal Cup
items.body: Compete in the Solo Reload Persona 5 Royal Cup or the Solo Zero Build Persona 5 Royal Cup now! Top regional performers will receive the Joker (P5R) Outfit. Find additional details in the Compete Tab.

items.title: Morgana Bus
items.body: Transform! Explore battlefields and beyond with the Morgana Bus vehicle, available in Battle Royale and Rocket League.

items.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!
items.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.

items.title: Fortnitemares Returns October 1
items.body: Press start to begin terror! Fortnitemares returns to Battle Royale on October 1.

items.title: Welcome to Gotham City!
items.body: Swing into action with Batman’s Grapnel Gun and Batarang as Gotham City lands in OG.
